_readme: NBA court library for the 2026-27 season. One entry per club, keyed by nickname slug (same slugs as the Cup image files). abbr = NBA tricode; schedulePost = the team's 2026-27 uniform schedule post slug.

courts holds one slot per floor type: regular (primary/Core home court), city (City Edition), classic (Classic Edition), cup (Emirates NBA Cup), statement (Statement court), playoff. null = not revealed yet or not in the repo yet. Add new slot keys (e.g. 'alternate') as needed.

Each filled slot: name, image (public path), sourceUrl (original post; null when our story did not record one), revealed (ISO date), description (factual, no grades), credit, and optionally post (our story slug), extraImages, firstUsed, sourceImage (original full-res URL).

Library images live under public/images/courts/nba/<season>/<slot>/<slug>.jpg; slots filled from older stories point at those stories' existing images instead of copying them. Run node scripts/compress-images.mjs after adding any image.

cup.name: Emirates NBA Cup 2026
cup.allCourtsComposite: https://media.nbcsportsphiladelphia.com/2026/10/All-Courts-Comms-and-Editorial-NBA-Cup-26-v4-1536x864-1.jpg (NBC Sports Philadelphia, league composite of all 30, 1536x864)

facts.fact: NBA unveiled all 30 team courts for the Emirates NBA Cup 2026 on Oct. 13, 2026 (@NBA thread 9:01 AM ET; @NBAPR: 'Cup games will be played on the custom-designed, fully painted courts').

Shared template on all 30: solid team-color painted playing surface with an oversized tonal brush-style team wordmark; team logo set on a gold NBA Cup trophy graphic at center court; gold trophy graphic filling each lane; city or team-name wordmarks on the baseline aprons; Emirates NBA Cup logos on the sideline apron; Michelob Ultra Courtside marks on the baselines; tagline '30 TEAMS. 8 ADVANCE. 1 CHAMPION.' near each corner three.
facts.source: Official renders in the @NBA thread https://x.com/NBA/status/2110038191545663961; tagline/trophy also in https://www.nbcsportsphiladelphia.com/nba/nba-cup-court-designs-2026/758456/ and https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/why-celtics-far-best-2026-185207647.html

facts.fact: Design inspired by Nike's 'End of Ordinary' NBA Standard Issue Collection; oversized wordmarks styled after the Nike Standard Issue jackets.

Group play: Oct. 30; Nov. 6, 13, 20, 24, 25 & 27 (Cup Nights Nov. 24-25). Quarterfinals Dec. 4-5, semifinals Dec. 8/9, Championship Fri. Dec. 11 at Hinkle Fieldhouse, Indianapolis (Prime Video). Three five-team groups per conference; group winners plus one wild card per conference advance.
Teams wear Statement Edition uniforms for all NBA Cup games; Knicks beat Spurs in last season's Cup final.
Prize money: more than $500,000 per player on the winning team (fourth edition).
